description.en: Frosted folders open into a fan of real files, with generated artwork, a drop-in add action, and keyboard menus.
description.zh: 磨砂文件夹展开为扇形文件，支持生成纹理、添加落入动效和键盘菜单。

keywords: glass folder files frosted blur art marble add fan menu 玻璃 文件夹 文件 磨砂 扇出 添加 菜单 纹理

discovery.caveat: 文件卡片展示界面；存储、上传与真实文件权限需接入项目。

instructions.en: Hover or focus to peek, click to open, and press + to add a file. The dark folder has a keyboard-accessible menu. All files are local demo state.
instructions.zh: 悬停或聚焦预览，点击展开，按 + 添加文件。深色文件夹带键盘菜单，所有文件均为本地演示状态。
